negativeValidatorCases.trigger: A browser client requests provider-backed answer generation with a browser-visible model key or direct model-call configuration.
negativeValidatorCases.requestedBehavior: Render a provider-backed answer from public client configuration.
negativeValidatorCases.failClosedReason: Provider-backed capabilities require service-side credential boundaries and no browser-visible model keys.

negativeValidatorCases.trigger: A receipt, support summary, issue-mining record, or public status event tries to include private prompt text.
negativeValidatorCases.requestedBehavior: Persist or expose the private prompt as diagnostics for support or mining.
negativeValidatorCases.failClosedReason: Receipts, public status, support summaries, and issue-mining metadata must use safe ids and summaries without private prompt expansion.

negativeValidatorCases.trigger: High-quality speech is unavailable and the requested fallback is medium-quality or low-quality audio.
negativeValidatorCases.requestedBehavior: Generate cheaper unsynchronized or lower-quality audio instead of the high-quality service-native speech path.
negativeValidatorCases.failClosedReason: V1 speech is high-quality only; unavailable high-quality speech falls back to displayed text with no low-quality audio charge.

negativeValidatorCases.trigger: A GitHub issue handoff is requested before the user confirms public visibility, destination, and included material.
negativeValidatorCases.requestedBehavior: Open or submit the GitHub issue without a final confirmation step.
negativeValidatorCases.failClosedReason: Public, external, durable, or credentialed actions require explicit action-broker confirmation before side effects.

negativeValidatorCases.trigger: A paid, retained, public, provider-backed, generated-media, or GitHub handoff action is requested under stale service terms.
negativeValidatorCases.requestedBehavior: Proceed with the action because the user accepted an older terms version.
negativeValidatorCases.failClosedReason: Paid, retained, public, provider-backed, generated-media, and credentialed features require current applicable terms and legal-review state.

negativeValidatorCases.trigger: Provider output, generated media polish, issue volume, token spend, or priority-only material attempts to upgrade a claim to published-corpus authority.
negativeValidatorCases.requestedBehavior: Raise the claim label or source class because the answer sounds convincing or because the user paid for a richer artifact.
negativeValidatorCases.failClosedReason: Only validated source context and answer-engine source rules can set claim labels; media quality, payment, provider output, and issue volume cannot strengthen authority.
